top_signals.title: Wall Street Profits Could Top $90 Billion, Says State Comptroller
top_signals.summary: Wall Street is racking up a potential record $90 billion in profits, supercharging New York’s tax revenues—but is this AI-fueled boom built to last? New York State Comptroller Thomas DiNapoli says if things stay on track, there could be a record increase in the banker bonus pool for next year. DiNapoli talks about his report on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
